# CreatorChahiye

> CreatorChahiye (formerly CreatorHive) is a founder-led influencer marketing agency in India for startups and D2C brands. It handles creator discovery, outreach and negotiation, campaign management, UGC, product seeding and reporting, and runs every campaign on a written agreement. It also runs a network of 5,000+ creators (nano to macro) across India.

Key facts:
- Name: CreatorChahiye. Former name: CreatorHive (same company, renamed in 2026). Former domain: creatorhive.in
- Founder: Karan Aryan
- Location served: India
- Contact: karan@creatorchahiye.com, WhatsApp +91 70655 55395
- Clients and work include T-Hub (creator-led startup stories), MI TUBE (creator acquisition and onboarding), Marg (influencer coordination) and Persaura (13-creator jewellery launch)

## Guides
- [Influencer Marketing Cost in India: What to Budget](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-marketing-cost-india/): Most Indian brands can run a meaningful micro-influencer campaign from roughly ₹25,000–₹50,000 in creator fees. What you actually pay depends on creator tier, format (Reel, Story, static), usage rights and exclusivity. Agency fees, product seeding and paid boosting come on top.
- [How to Choose Micro-Influencers in India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/how-to-choose-micro-influencers/): Choose micro-influencers on audience fit, not follower count. Check who follows them (city, age, interests), whether their engagement looks genuine, whether their content style suits your product, and test with a small paid pilot before scaling.
- [Influencer Marketing for Startups: Where to Start](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-marketing-for-startups/): Start with one goal, a small pilot of 5–10 nano and micro creators, a written brief, trackable links or codes, and a two-to-four-week review window. Learn from the pilot, then scale what worked.
- [How Small Creators Get Paid Brand Deals in India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/get-paid-brand-collaborations-instagram/): Pick a clear niche, put your audience data in a one-page media kit, set a fair starting rate, pitch brands that match your audience, and never start work without written terms covering deliverables, payment and usage rights.
- [Influencer Agency Fees in India: How They Work](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-marketing-agency-fees-india/): How influencer marketing agencies in India charge: flat fees, commission, retainers and shortlisting fees, plus the questions to ask before you sign.
- [What Is UGC? A Simple Guide for Indian Brands](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/what-is-ugc-india/): UGC explained for Indian brands: what user-generated content is, how it differs from influencer posts, where to use it and how to brief creators.
- [Influencer Agreement Checklist for India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-agreement-checklist-india/): A practical checklist of what an influencer agreement should cover in India: deliverables, payment, usage rights, exclusivity, approvals and disclosure.
- [How to Make a Media Kit as a Creator in India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/creator-media-kit-india/): How to build a one-page creator media kit in India: what to include, how to show audience data and past work, and how to share it with brands.
- [Influencer Campaign Metrics: What to Track](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-campaign-metrics-india/): Which metrics matter in an influencer campaign in India: reach, views, saves, clicks and conversions, and which vanity numbers to ignore.
- [Influencer Product Seeding: A Brand Guide](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/product-seeding-influencer-marketing/): What product seeding is, how it differs from paid influencer deals, who to send products to, what to include in the package and how to follow up in India.
- [Nano vs Micro Influencers: Which to Pick?](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/nano-vs-micro-influencers-india/): Nano vs micro influencers explained for Indian brands: follower ranges, engagement benchmarks, cost, workload and when to choose each tier.
- [Influencer Marketing for D2C Brands in India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/influencer-marketing-for-d2c-brands-india/): How D2C brands in India can use influencer marketing: market context, vernacular and short-form trends, when to go direct and when to use an agency.
- [How to Pitch Brands as a Creator: Email Guide](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/how-to-pitch-brands-as-a-creator-india/): How to pitch brands as a creator in India: the five parts of a good pitch email, subject line ideas, a template you can adapt and how to follow up.
- [How to Find Influencers in India](https://creatorchahiye.com/guides/how-to-find-influencers-for-your-brand-india/): Five ways to find influencers for your brand in India: manual search, hashtags, creator platforms, agencies and communities, with a vetting checklist.
